description_of_work: In order to accommodate the construction of the foundation for the 55 Wheeler St project, the following scope is required. The site will be secured by fencing and stabilized in accordance with an approved erosion control plan.  The utilities that currently service the existing buildings will be terminated by the appropriate utility companies and the existing structures will be abated of all hazardous materials. The structures will be completely demolished including structures and foundations. The existing site will also be cleared of all identified tree’s, asphalt parking surface and associated hardscape. The required foundations for the project will be located well below grade to accommodate one level of sub surface parking. We will install sheet piles just outside of the building footprint and at the entire perimeter of the new structure. The earth inside of the earth support will be analyzed for proper disposal and the overburden will be hauled off site and disposed of at an appropriate facility. During this excavation dewatering will be required and will be performed in accordance with an approved dewatering plan. When the sub grade is reached, the excavation will be appropriately prepared to receive formwork, and footings will be formed and poured. Currently we intend on starting the earthwork and foundations at the South end of the site and working towards the North, following the footing we will then proceed with the forming an pouring the exterior walls and internal pilasters which will eventually support the first floor deck. The footings, and walls will be backfilled and subgrade will be prepared so that the underground plumbing can be excavated and installed. After all underground utilities are completed we will pour the basement slab and eventually use this slab to shore off of for the support of the first floor deck.

Site access arrangement for emergency response vehicles: The main fire alarm entrance point is at the main entrance of the building. The main fire panel is located in the main entrance lobby. The main entrance shall have a key box, master box and fire alarm beacon located at the exterior. The building will have a new 4” fire service. A new 4” double check backflow preventor will be installed in the water service room. The building shall be protected by a new automatic fire sprinkler system. The building will have a fire department connection wet alarm valve. Flow control valve assemblies are located on the main service riser in the main stairwell on levels 1 through 4. The sprinkler system is currently zoned, with each zone being controlled by a zone control valve assembly. An alarm initiation signal shall be provided when the system operates, from the flow switches located down-stream of the zone control valves, or up-stream of the wet-pipe alarm valves. All control valves will have tamper switches. All new tamper and flow switches will be connected to the main fire alarm control panel. Wiring from all alarm and fault signaling devices shall form part of the fire detection and alarm contract.
